summary: AstraZeneca PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting that Non-Executive Director Rene Haas is stepping down on 30 April 2026 due to his additional role as CEO of SoftBank Group International. The departure is voluntary and mutually agreed, with no remuneration beyond standard board fees. The filing is a routine directorate change notice, not a forced or abrupt management departure that constitutes a special situation. There are no deal terms, shareholder influence, or strategic shifts. This is a standard governance update, so no special-situations category applies.
